response.sql: SELECT s.insurstat AS insurance_status, COUNT(DISTINCT s.zoneregistry) AS conserved_site_count, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT s.zoneregistry) AS NUMERIC) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT s.zoneregistry)) OVER () AS share FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.insurstat;
